name: flowstone
description: FEEL playground powered by the dsntk Rust engine compiled to WebAssembly (exact 34-digit decimals)

scripts.build:playground: npm run notices && npm run build -w @flowstone/playground

scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:rust:wasm && npm run test:runtime
